scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w stanza-docs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run docs:check
scripts.examples: node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/banded-cover && node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/classic-cover && node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/corporate-report && node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/imported-report && node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/plain-memo && node packages/cli/dist/main.js build examples/technical-note
scripts.docs:check: node packages/cli/dist/main.js validate docs && node packages/cli/dist/main.js format --check --assign-ids docs
